description: This file defines a Java interface 'ConnectionMetrics' which represents aggregated connection metrics including inbound and outbound metrics, along with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities. It also includes an inner class 'JsonFields' listing JSON field definitions related to connection metrics.

classes.name: ConnectionMetrics
classes.description: An interface representing connection metrics with methods to retrieve inbound and outbound metrics, and JSON serialization capabilities.

classes.name: ConnectionMetrics.JsonFields
classes.description: A utility class containing static definitions of JSON fields ('inbound' and 'outbound') used in connection metrics JSON representation.

methods.name: getInboundMetrics
methods.description: Returns the inbound AddressMetric for the connection.

methods.name: getOutboundMetrics
methods.description: Returns the outbound AddressMetric for the connection.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the connection metrics to a JSON object, considering only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the connection metrics to a JSON object based on a specific schema version and field selector.
